svg.title: Multipolar Neuron — Schematic
svg.desc: Original multipolar neuronal morphology with several shorter dendrite-like branches and one longer axon-like process. Branch number, caliber and terminal shapes are illustrative; no neuronal subtype or activity is asserted.
